The '''Siren's Soul''' was a set of crystals that could be used to produce [[Music/Legends|music]]. Each piece could produce a different sound, and the collection had an overall value of 75,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The [[Erla Tomvaas]] was a part of the Siren's Soul.<ref name="LoNH" />
